استحضرا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْضَرَا (istaḥḍarā) /is.taħ.dˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
# اُسْتُحْضِرَا (ustuḥḍirā) /us.tuħ.dˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
# اِسْتَحْضِرَا (istaḥḍirā) /is.taħ.dˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
